title: OpenAI says it corrected a GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol launch billing mistake that had incorrectly discounted usage; Astra users will now hit their limits 40% faster
html:
Thariq Shihipar joins OpenAI after leaving Anthropic in October, saying he felt he could “personally contribute the most” to bringing AI to the world at OpenAI  —  I've joined OpenAI! I'm very proud of my time at Anthropic, and I'll continue to root for my former colleagues. Both companies have important roles to play in the future.
